  "overall_experience": "This Ecommerce Manager likely found Basecamp to be a straightforward and generally easy-to-use tool for organizing projects within their small retail team. While appreciating its simplicity and ability to centralize team collaboration, they might have noticed a reduction in functionality compared to their previous experience with Asana, especially for more complex tasks or detailed reporting. Despite some minor navigation challenges with multiple projects, Basecamp effectively served their primary need for team project coordination."
